title: Check an athlete's licence at competition registration
summary: A sport federation or competition organiser checks at registration that an athlete holds a valid licence. Proposed by the Fachbereich E-ID; the issuer and the facts the verifier needs are open.
actors: Verifier: sport federation or competition organiser | Holder: athlete
review_notes: (1) Verifier: sport federation or competition organiser; verifier question: qualification. (2) Related: skydiving-licence-insurance (same pattern, other sector).
open_question: Which body issues athlete licences, and is a licence a credential in its own right or an attribute of membership?

title: Check that an online shop belongs to a registered company
summary: A consumer checks that an online shop belongs to a company entered in a register. Proposed by the Fachbereich E-ID; the authoritative register and the way the shop presents the proof are open.
actors: Verifier: consumer | Holder: online shop operator
review_notes: (1) Verifier: consumer; verifier question: identity. (2) Related: marketplace-merchant-verification (the same question asked by a marketplace); payments-lei-matching.
open_question: Which register is authoritative (commercial register UID, LEI), and how does the shop present it to the consumer?

title: Verify sender and recipient before a money transfer
summary: A bank or payment service provider verifies sender and recipient before executing a money transfer. Proposed by the Fachbereich E-ID; the attributes needed and the credentials that carry them are open.
actors: Verifier: bank or payment service provider | Holders: sender and recipient
review_notes: (1) Verifier: bank or payment service provider; verifier question: identity. (2) Related: wallet-ownership-institutional; payments-lei-matching.
open_question: Which attributes of sender and recipient does the bank need, and from which credentials?
